title: Close out Phase 3: retro + plan the next epic
description:
Run the epic retro, fold learnings into .tick/learnings.md inside the 150-line cap (compact, do not append — Phase 2's closeout had to drop three entries to pay for five), verify the epic outside-in against its definition of done with a REAL ingested signal end to end, then flesh out the next feasible epic.

Phase 2's closeout learned that the outside-in verification must be a live run, not a test suite, and that an honest 'this clause is not met, and here is the precise reason' is worth more than a green claim.
closed_reason: Completed: Phase 3 retro recorded on the epic; three new learnings folded into .tick/learnings.md at exactly the 150-line cap, paid for by compacting nine entries and dropping one; the epic verified outside-in against the deployed factory with a real GitHub webhook and real issues — unlabelled ignored, labelled drafted, nothing filed on arrival, redelivery deduped — with the Telegram half honestly recorded as not live-verified; repo-wiki/signal-ingestion.md written; Phase 4 (szp) planned into 7 ticks with its EPIC-SKELETON and a definition of done.
